attacks.name: Vibro-Shock Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Stun|: After the attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stun§Stun| special condition.

attacks.name: Shake ‘em Down
steps: |!wild| |*Stagger|: After the attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stagger§Stagger| special condition.

superPowers.name: Vibrational Shield
superPowers.body: When this character is targeted by a |!physical| or |!energy| attack it may use this superpower. Add 2 dice to this character's defense roll against that attack.

superPowers.name: If the Ground is Rocking...
superPowers.body: When an enemy character within |!range| 2 of this character makes an attack, it rolls 1 fewer die on its attack roll.
